items.a: 17705 Leslie Street, Unit 5, Newmarket, ON L3Y 3E3. We're the local spot for indoor golf for golfers from Newmarket, Aurora, East Gwillimbury, Bradford and across York Region.

items.q: How do I book a bay?
items.a: Book online any time, or call us at (905) 235-GOLF (4653). All four of our Golfzon simulators can be booked online. Walk-ins are welcome when a bay is free, but booking ahead is the best way to get the time you want.

We charge per bay, per hour, not per person, plus HST. Overnight on our automated bays (12 AM to 9 AM): $49.99. Monday to Thursday, 9 AM to 5 PM: $49.99. Monday to Thursday 5 PM to close, Friday 9 AM to 4 PM, and all day Sunday: $59.99. Friday 4 PM to close, all day Saturday and holidays: $69.99.

items.q: How many people can play, and for how long?
items.a: Up to four golfers per bay. Plan on about an hour per golfer for a full 18 holes, so a group of four usually books around four hours.

items.q: Is there a 24-hour golf simulator near Newmarket or Aurora?
items.a: Yes. Our two automated Golfzon bays in Newmarket can be booked online and played 24/7, including overnight from 12 AM to 9 AM at $49.99 per bay per hour plus HST. The bar side and its two staffed bays are open daily from 9 AM to 12 AM.
The bar side and its two bays are staffed daily from 9 AM to 12 AM. Our two automated bays can be booked online and played 24/7.
Yes. Gift cards are available online and in store.

items.q: Do I need to bring my own clubs?
items.a: You're welcome to bring your own, and rental clubs are available at the club.

items.q: I've never played. Is that okay?
items.a: Absolutely. Your handicap is welcome here, whatever it is. If you'd like a few pointers, book a private lesson with our pro, Andrew McDonald.
Choose from more than 200 courses, or warm up on the driving range, approach areas and putting green. Play stroke play, match play, scramble or skins.
Four Golfzon simulators: two TwoVision NX and two Vision Plus. They measure every shot, including ball speed, launch, spin and carry.

items.q: Do you have leagues and lessons?
items.a: Yes. Men's Night runs every Tuesday from November to April, The Bogey Cup is a new four-week tournament every month, and private lessons are one-on-one with Andrew McDonald, PGA of Canada. See Leagues & Events and Meet Our Pro.

items.q: Do you serve food and drinks?
items.a: Yes. We're fully licensed, with two full bars serving draft beer and cocktails, plus food and snacks. You must be 19 or older with valid ID to be served alcohol.
Yes, kids are welcome with an adult.

items.q: Can I host a birthday, work party or private event?
items.a: Yes. Our upstairs event space has its own full bar and is perfect for birthdays, corporate outings and celebrations. See Private Events to start planning.
Yes. Book karaoke online and grab the mic. It is never just one song.
